high_level_description: This image is a stunning photograph of a spiral galaxy, likely taken by a powerful telescope such as the Hubble Space Telescope. The galaxy is captured in a side-on view, showcasing its spiral arms extending outward from a bright central region. Galaxy Structure: The galaxy has a prominent central bulge, which is the densest part of the galaxy, containing a high concentration of stars and possibly a supermassive black hole.
